about: Measured apart: configuration files that are themselves code, which editor extensions load when the folder opens (ESLint, Prettier, Tailwind CSS IntelliSense, the Jest extension). Kept out of autorun-paths.json; see the doc for why.

entries.tool: VS Code extensions (ESLint, Prettier, Tailwind CSS, Jest, Vitest)
entries.trigger: the extension loads the configuration, which is JavaScript, when a file of the folder opens
